title: Evaluating Rational Contracting in Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2608.10475v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The emergence of language-based AI agents promises to transform the scope of machine economic activity. Instead of just proposing bids or following hard-coded protocols, such agents can be used to negotiate and execute agreements in natural language. However, most evaluations of these abilities have focused on one-off exchanges or simple economic games, leaving open the rich space of time-extended, contingent, and incomplete contracts expressible in language; they also focus on raw profit, without measuring the qualities required for trustworthy contracting. We address this by formulating a rational framework for how agents should negotiate and perform natural language contracts in uncertain multi-step environments. Using this framework, we develop metrics and baselines for quantifying rational and cooperative play. translated_title: 评估自然语言中的理性缔约
translated_abstract: 基于语言的AI智能体的出现，有望改变机器经济活动的范围。这类智能体不再只是提出竞价或遵循硬编码的协议，而是能够用自然语言进行协商并执行协议。然而，目前针对这些能力的大多数评估都集中在一次性交易或简单的经济博弈上，而尚未涉及语言所能表达的、时间上延展的、有条件依赖的以及不完全契约这一丰富的空间；此外，这些评估往往只关注原始利润，而没有衡量可信缔约所需的品质。为此，我们提出了一个理性框架，用以规范智能体在不确定的多步骤环境中应如何协商和履行自然语言契约。基于该框架，我们开发了用于量化理性与合作博弈行为的指标和基线。我们将该框架实例化为ContractSim——一个评估套件，其中两名玩家协商并执行一项多步骤契约（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个理性缔约框架和评估套件ContractSim，用于量化评估AI智能体在不确定多步骤环境中协商与履行自然语言契约时的理性与合作能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rational contracting framework and an evaluation suite, ContractSim, to measure how rationally and cooperatively AI agents negotiate and perform natural language contracts in uncertain multi-step environments.
